name: Chapa Quente
description: Marlene and Genésio are the typical couple with a volatile, love-hate relationship. She works hard, while he—a chronic loafer—constantly gets himself into major scrapes.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Marlene has to deal with a city inspector who wants to fine her salon; her husband uses a bar to sell cruise travel packages.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Genésio and Marreta organize the "Hot-Tempered Girl" contest; Fran has a revelation that could shake up Marlene's marriage.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Genésio starts working as a car salesman and decides to gift Marlene a used car. But, as expected, he doesn't have the money to pay for it and ends up getting into yet another mess with a coworker.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Fed up with the financial debt caused by her husband, Marlene kicks Genésio out in the middle of the night. It is a difficult situation for her, yet necessary: ​​the hairdresser cannot live without him, but she wants to prove to the neighbors that she is tough.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Marlene decides to get silicone implants after Genésio shows interest in women with that look—but not without first teasing him and the whole neighborhood crowd.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Josy quits her job at the salon after Fran criticizes her work; Genésio starts a new job as a real estate agent.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Marlene seeks a consultation with a Candomblé priestess, while Genésio goes for a job interview. But he isn't exactly a top-notch candidate.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The salon runs out of water because of Genésio. Consequently, Marlene has to take extreme measures to be able to work.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The reason why Fran stopped cutting the stars' hair has come to light, and Susana Vieira might be at the center of the story.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Marlene forgets Genésio's Valentine's Day gift; Josy is anticipating a marriage proposal.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Josy jumps to conclusions about Bigode's intentions; Marlene tries to prove she knows how to cook, but the task turns out to be harder than it looks.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Marlene discovers she is up to her neck in debt. But little does she know that things could get even worse for her and Genésio.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Marlene runs into her ex-fiancé and is left shaken; Tavares shows up to defend Genésio.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Marlene discovers that Nelson doesn't have as simple a life as it seems; Genésio visits the grave of Godzilla's mother.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Genésio makes the final preparations to open the new nightclub; Celma shows up at Marlene's salon.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Genésio introduces a new samba school and Marlene is invited to be the drum section queen; Celma brings yet another surprise for the salon owner.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Marlene gets another shock: Celma and Genésio have gotten engaged. But her problems only get worse when she ends up in jail.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Genésio and Celma are facing a relationship crisis; Marlene feels insecure about her relationship with Nelson; Josy gets an unpleasant surprise regarding Bigode.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: A beautiful new lieutenant arrives in São Gonçalo; Marlene visits Genésio in the hospital but is unhappy with the reason for his admission.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Marlene enters a lambada contest to spite Celma; Marreta and Godzilla get into a fight at Creuza's bar.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Marreta's cousin shows up surrounded by henchmen and threatens the nightclub; Marlene feels pressured to live with Nelson when he gets evicted.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: The big day for Jozy and Bigode has arrived, and they are getting married. Amidst this atmosphere of love, Marlene and Genésio must decide whether or not to get back together.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Celma’s madness in trying to drive a wedge between Genésio and Marlene reaches new extremes; a robbery at Creuza’s bar stirs up the neighborhood.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Genésio faces new legal problems and discovers that Marlene is pregnant; Marlene discovers that her relationship with Nelson might face competition.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Celma tries to kill Nelson; Bigode has to deal with having been kicked out of the house; Marlene and Genésio have to decide, once and for all, whether to get back together.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Marlene and Genésio end up on different cruises. Genésio discovers that Marlene is Moacir's daughter.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Genésio and Marreta are organizing a contest.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jurema Hall is finally opening its doors, and the region is eagerly anticipating the big party. There isn't a single resident of São Gonçalo who wants to miss the event. But wanting to go doesn't always mean being able to.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Marlene announces that she is going to get breast implants.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Marlene manages to bring Josy back to the salon.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Marlene discovers that Genésio is her competitor; Moacir says he will file for divorce to be with Celma; Moacir and Celma get intimate and are caught in the act; Marlene commits a gaffe at an awards ceremony; Bigode is arrested; Moacir finds out his wife has been shot; Josy gets Bigode out of jail; Marlene apologizes to Genésio.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Under suspicious circumstances, Congressman Moacir’s wife dies during a robbery. Living in a perpetual state of campaigning, he turns the wake into an opportunity to drum up votes, yet not everyone is convinced the incident was merely another act of violence. Godzilla has inside information suggesting the robbery was staged.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Celma sleeps with Genésio, and Marlene finds out. Fran's mother admits to stealing Marlene's car. Genésio attempts bribery and is arrested. Dona Marisa is arrested. Marlene asks her father for help getting Genésio out of jail. Josy considers having a child. Marlene's salon is robbed. Congressman Moacir apologizes to Genésio.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Marlene decides to host a big event at her father's house and invites friends over for a barbecue in grand style. With the best of intentions, she keeps everything casual—no fancy glassware or cutlery, and no one to wait on the guests. The only problem is that they expect the exact opposite and are far from pleased when they find themselves having to pitch in.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Marlene announces that the congressman will foot the bill for Genesinho's party. Bigode proposes having a child with Josy. Marlene helps Genésio make some money. Celma resorts to blackmail to get into the party. Celma chokes on a wedding ring hidden inside a *brigadeiro*. Celma and Marlene get into a scuffle in the ball pit. Marlene and Genésio sing "Happy Birthday" to Genesinho.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Genésio sets fire to the hall.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Marlene and Genésio’s days—or rather, hours—of single life are numbered. Godzila announces that the renovations on the couple's house are finally finished. And the news, which was meant to bring relief, ends up causing disappointment.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: “The coolest guy around—a legend! A round of applause for the king of São Gonçalo nightlife, Genésio Silva!” announces the TV host while interviewing Genésio. Surrounded by beautiful young women, the owner of the region’s most famous nightclub is living his best life. Meanwhile, watching the broadcast from home, his wife Marlene is devastated, grappling with a major midlife crisis.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: For years, Genésio has been betting on the same Mega Sena numbers without success. But this time, something tells him the wind is blowing in his favor. He organizes a group bet with his partners, Marreta and Godzila, and asks Marlene to go to the lottery shop to place the wager. As it happens, the hairdresser not only has little faith in her husband's luck but is also frantically trying to save her father's reputation.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Celma persisted until she finally managed to convince Congressman Moacir to marry her. But before facing the challenge of having her as First Lady, the politician will have to break the news of the wedding to Marlene. The hairdresser will be doubly disappointed: first, because her father is making his relationship official with her worst enemy, and second, because she herself never made it to the altar with Genésio.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After being shot at Jurema Hall in the previous episode, Genésio wakes up in a sort of limbo, where he encounters an angel—part street-smart hustler, part rapper—who bears his own likeness. Genésio asks for a second chance to change his fate: just 24 more hours of life, in exchange for which the emissary from the beyond would secure a much more impressive soul for his résumé. With this new opportunity, he does everything in his power to forge a new destiny.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Things are heating up more than ever in the season finale.
